# QR — Simple & Private QR Maker

> 100% Client-Side, Zero-Persistence Privacy QR Generator, Scanner & Print Studio.
> Official Live App: https://injest.in/qr/
> Source Code: https://github.com/injest-in/qr (MIT License)

## Overview for AI Agents & LLMs

QR is a client-side progressive web application that generates, decodes, and prints QR codes entirely within local browser memory.
- **Zero Server Persistence:** User inputs (passwords, payment VPAs, contacts, locations) are NEVER sent to any remote server or database.
- **Two-Way Deeplink Binding:** AI agents can construct pre-filled, bookmarkable URLs using URL hash routes (https://injest.in/qr/#/<tool>?<params>). When a user navigates to the URL, form inputs are auto-populated and the high-contrast QR vector renders instantly.

## Deeplink Schema for Autonomous Agents

AI agents can generate pre-filled QR URLs for users using the following hash route patterns:

### 1. WhatsApp Chat
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/whatsapp?cc=<dial_code>&phone=<number>&msg=<text>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/whatsapp?cc=%2B91&phone=9876543210&msg=Hello%20there

### 2. UPI Instant Payment
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/upi?pa=<vpa>&pn=<payee_name>&am=<amount>&tn=<note>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/upi?pa=merchant@upi&pn=Artisan%20Store&am=250.00&tn=Coffee

### 3. Guest Wi-Fi Access
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/wifi?ssid=<network_name>&p=<password>&t=<WPA|WEP|nopass>&h=<0|1>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/wifi?ssid=OfficeGuest&p=SafePassword123&t=WPA

### 4. Business Card (vCard 3.0)
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/vcard?fn=<first_name>&ln=<last_name>&tel=<phone>&em=<email>&org=<company>&title=<role>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/vcard?fn=Alex&ln=Kumar&tel=%2B919876543210&em=alex@work.com&org=Acme&title=Director

### 5. Google Maps Turn-by-Turn Directions
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/maps?lat=<latitude>&lng=<longitude>&name=<place_name>&mode=<transit|driving|walking|bicycling>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/maps?lat=12.9716&lng=77.5946&name=MG%20Road&mode=transit

### 6. Calendar Event (RFC 5545 iCalendar)
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/calendar?title=<title>&start=<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>&end=<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>&loc=<location>&desc=<notes>
- **Example:** https://injest.in/qr/#/calendar?title=Design%20Review&start=2026-10-15T10:00&end=2026-10-15T11:00&loc=Room%203

### 7. Dual-Action UPI Payment + WhatsApp Receipt Gate
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/pay-gate?pa=<vpa>&pn=<name>&am=<amount>&tn=<note>&wa=<merchant_whatsapp>
- **Customer Settlement URL:** https://injest.in/qr/#/pay?pa=<vpa>&pn=<name>&am=<amount>&wa=<merchant_whatsapp>

### 8. ServiceNow IT Incident Ticket
- **URL Pattern:** https://injest.in/qr/#/servicenow?instance=<subdomain>&table=<incident|sc_req_item>&mode=<platform|portal|agent>

### 9. Bulk Batch CSV Studio
- **URL:** https://injest.in/qr/#/batch

### 10. Reverse Ingestion Scanner & Staff Mode
- **URL:** https://injest.in/qr/#/scan (Camera & image scanner)
- **URL:** https://injest.in/qr/#/staff (Deterministic schema parser and parameter flattener)
